patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: The parents report no known allergies, normal birth and developmental history for the child.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies fever, rash, or recent illnesses.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with swelling in the right knee and a familial history of similar problems.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “My right knee has been swollen since we came back from the park, and we didn’t see any real injury or accident. I’ve also been feeling okay otherwise—no fever or rash—and my mom says an uncle in the family had similar knee problems.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any areas of skin that are scratched, rubbed raw, or have small open spots (excoriations) anywhere on your body?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t had any itchy spots, scratches, or any open sores that I can tell you about—my skin looks normal.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or you wake up gasping for air during sleep? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any times where I stop breathing or wake up gasping—I sleep like usual.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—like severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using the area normally? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No—there wasn’t any noticeable severe pain, bruising, deformity, or trouble using my right knee; it’s mainly just swollen.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared to the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist—my skin on that side looks about the same as the other.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, dark or discolored areas on the chest), especially after an injury, coughing, or strain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bruising on my chest wall—no dark or discolored spots from any injury, coughing, or straining.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I’m peeing about the same as usual—no extra trips or bigger amounts. Everything else seems normal, and I’ve just been having the swelling in my right knee.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances such as alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs in the past or currently?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t used alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or any other drugs—nothing like that for me.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking urine or not making it to the bathroom in time? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any trouble controlling my urine—no leaking and I’m able to go when I need to.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any new or changing skin spot, sore, or growth anywhere on your body (for example, a mole that’s changing, a persistent rash, or a wound that won’t heal)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any new or changing skin spots, sores, rashes, or any wound that won’t heal anywhere on my body. The only thing I’ve really been noticing is the swelling in my right knee.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even a small amount of blood from one or both nostrils)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any nosebleeds recently—no blood from my nose at all. The only problem I’ve noticed is the swelling in my right knee.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rash on your trunk (chest, back, or belly)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rash on my trunk—my chest, back, and belly look normal, and I haven’t had any itchy or irritated skin.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in your legs (varicose veins), especially around the calves or ankles?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in my legs, and my calves and ankles look normal to me.”
